_doc: G1: the starts the menu of GB.exe offers for a new god's game (Editor/src/GameShell.cpp). label and tip are English; the interface translates them (assets/ui/lang/es.json, ui). biome: temperate, alpine or desert; 1 to 6 clans of 2 to 40 people; bare: the clans start with their land and a well and raise their villages themselves; speed: the clock's speed at the start (1 to 20). Not part of the content pack: the simulation never reads it. G5 adds the custom maps. The first is the menu's default (the playtest starts from nothing, 2026-11-17).

presets.label: From nothing
presets.tip: Three clans with nothing built: watch them raise their villages

presets.label: Living valley
presets.tip: Three clans with their villages standing, in a temperate valley

presets.label: Hard mountains
presets.tip: Two clans in the mountains: cold winters and little food
